Compounding planning errors over long horizons: sequential LLM calls accumulate errors multiplicatively; compilation + verification + lazy replanning contains error within deterministic runtime — prior used to prioritize O(1) compilation vs continuous loop economics, not SPIDER-established

Retrieval is not reasoning: RAG matches lexical similarity but does not compose mechanisms; joint multi-channel (header+body+query+auth) composition requires invariant pre/postconditions — prior explains Frontier 0/10 mixed failure, not yet SPIDER-proven on live sites

Measurement traps dominate: leakage (target_href==url), smoothing bias (Laplace q cell count), oracle stop conditions and degenerate CIs can fake significance; strong nulls and held-out website splits are non-optional — prior used to demand shuffled-action null and header-only vs body baselines

Economics must be end-to-end amortized: per-task tokens+browser+retrieval+verification+repair+maintenance / successes at frequency f, not single-turn resolution rate — prior mandates per-trajectory-reset sum counters with |rho_shuffled|<0.20 and trajectory-grouped bootstrap, vs SPIDER's prior bijective formula
